hypothesis: Including camp-to-altar walking and tribute duration in farm selection will increase matched development win rate and mean submitted gems without new bot faults.
falsifier: Non-positive matched win-rate change, non-increasing mean submitted gems, or any new bot fault. Unchanged arena selection gates remain authoritative.
bottleneck: Current score ignores mandatory delivery after every positive bag; this is a source deduction, not an observed per-turn cause of the Ambush losses.

policy.static_distance: One terrain-only native multi-source field from free altar approaches; cache minimum distance over each group spawn mask. Ignore future units, camps and locks explicitly.
policy.ranking: Existing ingress/clear/capture cost plus ceil(delivery_steps/base_move_speed) and SDK-configured tribute duration, divided by gems + 0.12*gold; existing 0.85 commitment multiplier retained.
policy.unreachable: Exclude positive-gem groups with no static walking route to an altar approach.
policy.channel_estimate: Use full static group gems; actual shared collection can make this an overestimate.
policy.fuel: No new per-turn graph search; one initialization field, cached per-group integers, old 30k planner/10k action fallback guards retained.
policy.scope: Draft, combat, banking actions, channels, shop/recall, dynamic reachability and capture/respawn semantics retained.

attribution: These losses evaluated 72b489b0, not the restored ff511c52 edit base or this candidate. Low collection without faults/suspensions/PvP motivates economy work but does not prove the omitted delivery term caused defeat.

opponent_source_audit.policy: Random stat Power build and random draft; bounded reset/damage ranking, enemy-first combat, union-of-spawns farming, bank any bag. No explicit delivery term. This is the supplied opponent for both Ambush losses.
Varg/Tavi/Ryth opening; recovery latch, shield/dash/route locks, bounded 12-group geometry shortlist and separate economy penalty. Keep gamma policies, use no copied private state.
Timestamped private camp respawn observations including return-at-arrival eligibility; this is a distinct possible future rotation experiment.

rejected_alternatives: Do not repeat rejected broad target-aware combat, camp claims, threat-aware banking, protected transit or Ryth swap without changed evidence.
Do not bundle the latest bounded farming shortlist or unselected capture-entry change.
Bank batching changes risk and reward cadence; test the missing delivery cost under the existing bank-any-bag policy first.
risks: Static minimum delivery distance ignores current occupancy and can underestimate large-group collection position.
Full reward channel estimate overpenalizes shared captures.
Delivery penalty can encourage gold-only camps or excessive competition near altars.
First farm initialization adds one native field computation; normal fuel checks remain necessary.
rules_references: .agent/knowledge/sources/BotAPICpp.md distance_field::compute and camp_group static reward APIs
rules_limits: Unchanged-doc routine iteration. Organizer hub/production parity limitations retained; no fresh official-policy certification.

contrasting_wins.limit: Same evaluated source as Ambush losses; smoke opponent version unknown, different map/opponent is not a controlled performance comparison.

source_audit.regressions: Compile-time assertions in actual farm_value score: delivery reverses equal-reward choices, rich far group remains competitive, zero-gem camps pay no bank cost, walking rounds ceil at speed 2, invalid zero-speed design denominator bounded at 1.
